podcast.body: An EP released in 1998, serving as an interim release between the "Underdogs" album and "Beautiful Midnight." This EP notably included a cover of a Depeche Mode song. "The Matthew Good Band from a quick EP called Low-Five Besides, released in 1998."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 1
